overview: The Community Development Board endorsed a lot line adjustment for Magoon Avenue and conducted an extensive working session to refine the draft Boston Avenue Neighborhood Corridor District zoning. The Board reached consensus on several residential and student housing standards but determined that development incentives for affordability require further technical overhaul.

items.title: Approval Not Required (ANR) Plan – 52 Magoon Avenue
items.summary: Endorsed an approval-not-required plan for a lot line adjustment to create a more buildable parcel and authorized the Planning Director to sign the registry plan.

items.title: Boston Avenue Zoning – Parking and Transit Standards
items.summary: Reached consensus to lower residential parking requirements to 1.0 space per unit for initial units and to mandate secure bicycle storage in new developments.

items.title: Boston Avenue Zoning – Institutional and Student Housing Uses
items.summary: Determined that fraternities and sororities should be prohibited in the corridor while classifying dormitories as a use requiring Board approval.

items.title: Boston Avenue Zoning – Purpose-Built Student Housing Standards
items.summary: Refined operational standards for student housing, including a 150-bed minimum, 24-hour on-site management requirements, and a cap on non-student occupancy.

items.title: Boston Avenue Zoning – Dimensional and Historic Standards
items.summary: Discussed setbacks and sidewalk widths, agreeing on a 10-foot sidewalk minimum and adjusting language regarding height exemptions for mechanical equipment and historic building eligibility.

items.title: Boston Avenue Zoning – Affordability Incentives
items.summary: Discussed technical flaws in the incentive tables that fail to produce additional affordable units for smaller projects and noted that the system requires a significant overhaul.

items.title: Routine Business and Adjournment
items.summary: Approved meeting minutes and adjourned the meeting.

subject: Boston Avenue Neighborhood Corridor District Zoning
